title: The Three Little Pigs
description: Three pig brothers learn why working hard is the best way to stay safe.
moral: Hard work and preparation keep you safe.

title: The Tortoise and the Hare
description: A slow tortoise and a speedy hare race to the finish line.
moral: Slow and steady wins the race.

title: Goldilocks and the Three Bears
description: A curious girl discovers a bear family's home in the woods.
moral: Always respect others' belongings.

title: Little Red Riding Hood
description: A brave girl carries food to grandmother and outwits a cunning wolf.
moral: Stay safe and don't talk to strangers.

title: The Ugly Duckling
description: An awkward young bird discovers his true beautiful self.
moral: Everyone has their own unique beauty.

title: The Lion and the Mouse
description: A tiny mouse repays a mighty lion's kindness in an unexpected way.
moral: Even the smallest friend can make a big difference.

title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
description: A hardworking ant and a carefree grasshopper face a long winter.
moral: Prepare today for the challenges of tomorrow.

title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
description: A shepherd boy learns a hard lesson about honesty.
moral: Honesty is always the best policy.

title: Jack and the Beanstalk
description: A boy trades a cow for magic beans and discovers a giant's castle in the clouds.
moral: Bravery and quick thinking can overcome great challenges.

title: The Frog Prince
description: A princess's promise to a frog leads to a magical transformation.
moral: Keep your promises, no matter what.

title: Cinderella
description: A kind girl's dreams come true with a little magic and a glass slipper.
moral: Kindness and patience are always rewarded.

title: Snow White
description: A princess befriends seven dwarfs while hiding from a jealous queen.
moral: True beauty comes from within.

title: Sleeping Beauty
description: A princess cursed to sleep is awakened by true love's kiss.
moral: Love can break even the most powerful of spells.

title: Rapunzel
description: A girl with magical long hair escapes a tower with the help of a brave prince.
moral: Freedom and love are worth any risk.

title: Beauty and the Beast
description: A brave girl looks past appearances and discovers the heart of a beast.
moral: True love looks beyond appearances.

title: Aladdin
description: A street boy finds a magic lamp and a genie who grants three wishes.
moral: Be yourself — that is your greatest treasure.

title: The Little Mermaid
description: A young mermaid dreams of life on land and follows her heart.
moral: Follow your dreams, but stay true to who you are.

title: Hansel and Gretel
description: Two siblings use their wits to escape a witch's candy house in the forest.
moral: Cleverness and courage can get you out of any trouble.

title: Thumbelina
description: A tiny girl born from a flower finds her place in a big world.
moral: Even the smallest person has a big destiny.

title: Puss in Boots
description: A clever cat helps his poor master rise to fame and fortune.
moral: Wit and loyalty are more valuable than gold.
